content.short: CertiK provides blockchain security services including audits, formal verification, Skynet monitoring, and compliance tools.
content.description: CertiK is a blockchain security company focused on helping protocols, exchanges, and infrastructure teams reduce technical and operational risk. Its official services cover smart contract audits, formal verification, penetration testing, bug bounty programs, Proof of Reserves, validator and node support, and compliance offerings. CertiK also operates Skynet and related intelligence products for continuous monitoring and threat detection after launch. In the TON ecosystem, its role is as an external security and assurance provider rather than a consumer-facing app or protocol.
